data.summary: The mage forms the orb and presents a single duck, then looks toward camera and smiles. His right hand lowers out of view before the duck appears and stays absent, so the two-hand composition is incomplete.

observations.text: The referenced silver-haired mage and navy/gold costume remain recognizable. His right hand traces a circle above the open left palm while gold rings form an orb.
The right hand leaves the left edge around two seconds. A bright flash near 2.5 seconds reveals one yellow duck that settles on the same left palm. The mage looks down at the toy.
The same duck stays on the visible palm, briefly opening its beak. The mage looks toward camera and smiles. The push-in retains head, duck and left palm but does not recover the right hand.
